items.sentence: The hikers will pause next to the cool mountain stream.

The brown bear will sacrifice its warm seat for a friend.
The generous baker offered extra rolls to every child.
Today, warm boots are appropriate for a walk in deep snow.
Two puppies cheerfully chase a rolling red ball outside.
The helpful robots deserve a colorful medal for their work.

A lie breaks trust, although no written law was broken.
